question: How many iron ingots do you need to craft a bucket?
gold_query: MATCH (:Item {name:'Bucket'})<-[:CREATES]-(:Recipe)-[q:REQUIRES]->(:Item {name:'Iron Ingot'}) RETURN q.count AS gold

question: What does a creeper drop when you kill it?
gold_query: MATCH (:Action:Kill)-[:REQUIRES]->(:Mob {name:'Creeper'}) MATCH (a:Action:Kill)-[:CREATES]->(i:Item) WHERE (a)-[:REQUIRES]->(:Mob {name:'Creeper'}) RETURN DISTINCT i.name AS gold

question: How many oak planks do you get from crafting one oak log?
gold_query: MATCH (:Item {name:'Oak Planks'})<-[c:CREATES]-(:Recipe)-[:REQUIRES]->(:Item {name:'Oak Logs'}) RETURN c.count AS gold

question: What is the maximum level of the Efficiency enchantment?
gold_query: MATCH (e:Enchantment {name:'Efficiency'}) RETURN e.maxLevel AS gold

question: What do you smelt in a furnace to get an iron ingot?
gold: Raw Iron (also Iron Ore and Deepslate Iron Ore)
gold_query: MATCH (:Item {name:'Iron Ingot'})<-[:CREATES]-(r:Recipe {type:'smelting'})-[:REQUIRES]->(x) WHERE x.name = 'Raw Iron' RETURN x.name AS gold

question: In the highest iron ore band of the Overworld (the one that spans y 80 to 319), at what y level does iron ore generation peak?
gold_query: MATCH (:Block {name:'Iron Ore'})<-[:CREATES]-(:Feature)<-[:PLACES]-(p:PlacedFeature)-[:IN_DIMENSION]->(:Dimension {name:'Overworld'}) WHERE p.minY = 80 RETURN p.peakY AS gold

question: What is the highest y level at which coal ore can generate in the Overworld?

question: A farmer villager buys 20 wheat for an emerald. How many times can that trade be used before the villager has to restock?

question: Which mob spawns naturally in the greatest number of different biomes?
gold: Enderman (61 biomes; the next, Bat and Skeleton, 54)

question: What do you craft a copper spear from?
